comment: The knobs are drawn at runtime, so the panel SVG shows only their positions; the render in the maker's own documentation (docs/modules/vx-drums/front-panel.png at commit 4588d09, the v2.47.0 release) was used for the panel lettering. The SHAPE row's parameter names in the census — BD Punch, SD Snap, CP Spread, PERC Drive, CH Metal, OH Metal — are the names of the House kit's models, and they change with the model loaded in each column; the panel prints SHAPE throughout. The KIT display is a custom widget with no parameter, so it cannot be clicked for help and is covered by a note.
